easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast Phyrexian Walker.
You control at least one additional creature,
description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying its mana cost.
When Phyrexian Walker enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Phyrexian Walker and one other creature you control, returning Phyrexian Walker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
